title: Pretty good knife in the kitchen
text: Pretty good knife in the kitchen. I like this one pretty well, wish it was a bit sharper on arrival. I ended up getting a Mercer that is similar (not santoku but 5"). The mercer was certainly sharper out of the packaging. Good size and balance with this one, just will need to use your sharpening stones to get it just right as far as sharpness.
